standingLines.line: 🌿 A person, maybe 40s, with deep-set eyes checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~7 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🍽️ Darnell takes one look at the full shelves and unshoulders the pack. "Leave the wild standing. Hauling water for the cistern."

🔥 The fire settles. Rini has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A red moon rising between the trees, breathing — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raj breathes "And you're still standing." the person in their 40s, with tattooed arms asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1 is halfway there (3/5 kills — the ledger counts kills only, not near-misses).

📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

🌿 Marta checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

🔥 The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Stella asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Stella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Bassam asks "Say that again — slower." Brian mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1's bar is full (5/5 — kills only, not near-misses).
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
"We've been watching you figure things out all week! This one's on us — a head start! But the REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
